It is not periodically refreshed for unchanged ID; stop does not clear last-scared ID. Reuse canonical FEAR consumer. Native running changes speed base to float.4 and sprint; clears to.25. Stealth visibility fraction.2; sitting/sleeping/holding substitutes ZERO own travel and stops navigation, jump prohibited for sitting/sleeping. Citadel collision admits bamboo/leaves, native evaluator treats them OPEN, not terrain deletion. Water slowdown float.99. Exact checkFallDamage override is empty; obsolete two-argument fall overload is not a universal source veto. Baby anger goal alerts adults then stops; player acquisition denies blessing and baby, interval100, follow4; tagged prey interval220 denies baby.
